zh: 我以前很少运动，现在每周游泳两次。
old_en: I used to rarely exercise, but now I swim twice a week.
new_en: I used to exercise rarely, but now I swim twice a week.

zh: 以前我几乎不运动，现在每周去游两次泳。
old_en: I used to hardly ever exercise, but now I swim twice a week.
new_en: I used to hardly ever exercise, but now I swim twice a week.

zh: 我以前总吃外卖，现在一般自己做饭。
old_en: I used to always order takeout, but now I usually cook myself.
new_en: I used to always order takeout, but now I usually cook at home.

zh: 以前我几乎天天点外卖，现在每天自己做饭。
old_en: I used to order takeout almost every day, but now I cook every day.
new_en: I used to order takeout almost every day, but now I cook every day.

zh: 我以前经常熬夜，现在十一点就睡了。
old_en: I used to stay up late often, but now I go to bed at ten o'clock.
new_en: I used to stay up late often, but now I go to bed at eleven.

zh: 以前我总要熬到一两点，现在尽量十一点睡。
old_en: I used to have to stay up until one or two, but now I try to be in bed by ten.
new_en: I used to stay up until one or two, but now I try to be in bed by eleven.

zh: 我以前每天喝奶茶，现在改喝水了。
old_en: I used to drink milk tea every day, but now I just drink water.
new_en: I used to drink milk tea every day, but now I only drink water.

zh: 以前我一天一杯奶茶，现在基本只喝水。
old_en: I used to have one cup of milk tea a day, but now I mostly just drink water.
new_en: I used to have one cup of milk tea a day, but now I mostly just drink water.

zh: 我以前几乎不走路，现在每天走一万步。
old_en: I used to hardly ever walk, but now I take 10,000 steps every day.
new_en: I used to hardly ever walk, but now I walk 10,000 steps every day.

zh: 以前我出门就坐车，现在每天走路一万步。
old_en: I used to always take a ride when going out, but now I walk 10,000 steps every day.
new_en: I used to always take a ride when going out, but now I walk 10,000 steps every day.

zh: 我以前不吃早饭，现在每天都吃。
old_en: I used to never eat breakfast, but now I eat it every day.
new_en: I used to never eat breakfast, but now I eat it every day.

zh: 以前我早上什么都不吃，现在每天都会吃早饭。
old_en: I used to eat nothing for breakfast in the morning, but now I always eat breakfast every day.
new_en: I used to eat nothing for breakfast, but now I always have breakfast every day.

zh: 我以前很少吃蔬菜，现在每餐都有。
old_en: I used to rarely eat vegetables, but now I have them at every meal.
new_en: I used to eat few vegetables, but now I have them at every meal.

zh: 我以前从来不体检，现在每年查一次。
old_en: I used to never get checked, but now I check every year.
new_en: I used to never have a check-up, but now I get one every year.

zh: 以前我几乎不吃青菜，现在每顿都吃蔬菜。
old_en: I used to hardly eat vegetables, but now I have them at every meal.
new_en: I used to hardly eat green vegetables, but now I have them at every meal.

zh: 我以前周末都在家躺着，现在会去爬山。
old_en: I used to lie around at home on weekends, but now I go hiking.
new_en: I used to stay at home on weekends, but now I go hiking.

zh: 以前我周末不出门，现在每周末都去爬山。
old_en: I used to stay indoors on weekends, but now I go hiking every weekend.
new_en: I used to stay indoors on weekends, but now I go hiking every weekend.

zh: 我以前总喝咖啡，现在改喝茶了。
old_en: I used to drink coffee all the time, but now I prefer tea.
new_en: I used to drink coffee all the time, but now I drink tea.

zh: 以前我每天喝好几杯咖啡，现在主要喝茶。
old_en: I used to drink several cups of coffee every day, but now I mainly drink tea.
new_en: I used to drink several cups of coffee every day, but now I mainly drink tea.

zh: 以前我觉得体检没必要，现在每年都会去检查。
old_en: I used to think health check-ups weren't necessary, but now I go every year.
new_en: I used to think health check-ups weren't necessary, but now I get one every year.
